# Tripoto

> > Tripoto is a travel community platform for discovering destinations, planning itineraries, sharing travel stories, and booking tour packages across India, Dubai, Thailand, Singapore, and global destinations.

Tripoto serves Indian travelers with user-generated travel content, destination guides, accommodation listings, and tour package bookings. The platform combines community-driven travel stories with practical booking services for domestic and international destinations.

## Key Topics

- Travel community and photo sharing
- Tour package booking
- Itinerary planning and discovery
- Destination guides for Indian travelers
- Dubai and UAE travel
- Thailand and Singapore destinations
- Abu Dhabi attractions
- Homestays and accommodation
- Visa-free countries for Indians
- Australia and Adelaide tourism
- Africa and Mount Kilimanjaro trekking
- Weekend getaways
- Travel partnerships
- User-generated travel stories

## Platform Overview

- [Tripoto: Share & Plan Travels With Community, Discover Places to Visit & Book Tour Packages](https://www.tripoto.com): Main homepage: Travel community for discovering & booking tour packages
- [How it Works | Tripoto](https://www.tripoto.com/how-it-works): Guide explaining Tripoto features: itineraries, stories, community connect
- [How it Works | Tripoto (CDN)](https://cdn.tripoto.com/how-it-works): Platform features guide: travel itineraries, photo sharing, expert tips

## Popular Destinations

- [Addis Ababa Travel Guide 2026](https://www.tripoto.com/addis-ababa): Addis Ababa destination page: Ethiopia capital travel guide & itineraries

- [8 DAYS LEMOSHO ROUTE (Mount Kilimanjaro Summit)](https://www.tripoto.com/africa/trips/8-days-lemosho-route-mount-kilimanjaro-summit-5ef9cad99caad): 8-day Lemosho Route itinerary for Mount Kilimanjaro summit via Shira Plateau

- [Visit UAE Now: The Rank 2 On The List Of Safest Countries In The World By WEF](https://www.tripoto.com/abu-dhabi/trips/safest-countries-in-the-world): UAE ranks 2nd in World Economic Forum's safest countries list
